product.name: Career Mentorship Community
product.tagline: Professionals offer 30-min mentorship sessions; mentees book and leave public reviews

sections.problem_statement: Mid-career professionals in India struggle to find high-quality, actionable career guidance beyond generic LinkedIn networking. Existing platforms like ADPList or Topmate are either globally focused or lack contextual understanding of the Indian corporate ecosystem, leaving a void for hyper-local career pathing. This product solves this by creating a verified, community-driven marketplace that democratizes access to industry veterans via structured, review-backed 30-minute sessions.
target_users: Ananya, Product Manager at a Series-B Fintech, struggling to transition into a leadership role without a dedicated mentor.
Rahul, Software Engineer at a WITCH company, feeling stuck in a legacy tech stack and needing a roadmap to transition to Cloud/AI.
Vikram, VP of HR at a mid-sized enterprise, looking to build his personal brand and give back while monetizing his 15+ years of experience.
user_stories: As a mentee, I want to filter mentors by company and industry so that I can find someone who understands my specific career trajectory.
As a mentor, I want to set my availability and pricing so that I can manage my time effectively and monetize my expertise.
As a mentee, I want to leave a public, verified review after my session so that I can help others identify high-quality mentors.
As a mentor, I want to see a mentee's pre-session questionnaire so that I can prepare relevant advice and maximize the 30-minute window.
As a platform admin, I want to automate payout workflows so that mentors receive their earnings within 48 hours via UPI/NEFT.
mvp_features: Identity Verification: LinkedIn OAuth integration to verify user seniority and company details, ensuring trust in the ecosystem.
Smart Scheduling: Google Calendar integration to prevent double-booking and automate timezone management for remote sessions.
Structured Booking Flow: A mandatory pre-session intake form to ensure the 30-minute call is focused and goal-oriented.
Review & Rating Engine: Post-session feedback mechanism that publishes verified reviews to mentor profiles to build social proof.
Integrated Video Conferencing: In-browser WebRTC video calls to eliminate the need for third-party Zoom/Meet links.
Secure Payment Gateway: Razorpay integration for seamless INR transactions, including automated GST-compliant invoicing.
future_features: Group Mentorship: Allowing mentors to host 1-to-many sessions to increase their hourly earnings and reach.
Corporate Partnerships: B2B dashboard for companies to subsidize mentorship sessions as part of their L&D budget.
AI-Matching Engine: Using NLP to match mentees with mentors based on profile data and career goals to improve conversion.
In-app Resource Library: Allowing mentors to sell pre-recorded courses or document templates alongside 1-on-1 sessions.
success_metrics: Booking Conversion Rate: 15% of profile views resulting in a booking within 3 months — indicates relevance of mentor inventory.
Session Completion Rate: 90% of booked sessions held successfully within 6 months — measures platform reliability and user intent.
Repeat Mentee Rate: 20% of mentees booking a second session within 60 days — validates the quality of advice provided.
Mentor NPS: Average mentor satisfaction score of 4.5+ to ensure the supply side remains engaged and active.
assumptions: Indian professionals are willing to pay for career guidance if the mentor is from a 'dream' company or holds a senior title.
The 30-minute time-box is sufficient to provide value, avoiding the fatigue of long-form consulting.
LinkedIn remains the primary professional identity source for the Indian workforce.
risks: Mentor 'ghosting' or poor quality advice → Implement a strict 'no-show' refund policy and mentor banning threshold.
Data privacy and DPDP Act compliance → Store user PII in encrypted Indian-based servers with clear consent management.
Platform leakage (mentors taking users off-platform) → Provide value-add features like automated invoicing and scheduling that are hard to replicate manually.
sections.go_to_market: Launch via a 'Founding Mentors' program targeting 50 high-profile leaders from top Indian startups and MNCs to build initial supply. Acquisition will focus on LinkedIn organic content and community engagement in professional WhatsApp/Slack groups. The first 100 customers will be acquired via direct outreach and a referral program that grants discounted sessions for inviting peers.
sections.tech_stack_suggestion: Use a no-code/low-code stack with Bubble.io or Webflow for the frontend, integrated with Xano for the backend database. Use Razorpay for payment processing and Calendly/Google Calendar APIs for scheduling, keeping the architecture lean to prioritize rapid iteration. Ensure all integrations are compliant with RBI’s digital payment guidelines.
sections.monetisation: Implement a 20% commission model on every booked session, keeping the barrier to entry low for mentors. Offer three tiers: Entry (INR 499), Mid (INR 1499), and Leadership (INR 2999) based on mentor seniority. Future revenue will pivot to a subscription-based 'Mentorship-as-a-Benefit' model for SMEs and startups.
